title: Mallard Charters
specs: Fishing within a 30 minute run from Kentmorr Marina to best fishing grounds in Chesapeake Bay
Alcohol allowed for those 21 yrs and older
No drugs and no parties over 6 persons
includes: Peanuts, crackers, granola bars and water always available onboard
blurb: Mallard Charters offers full day and half day fishing charters targeting species like Rockfish, Perch, Bluefish, and more. They also offer crabbing charters and event cruises such as weddings and bachelor/bachelorette parties. Trips depart from Kentmorr Marina on Kent Island, Maryland.
extraNote: Mate tip not included; 20% tip customary · Departure times subject to change depending on time of year, weather and distance to fishing grounds · 3% transaction fee added for credit card payments · Slip #10 on the North (restaurant) side of Kentmorr Marina, Kent Island, MD
